en-AU.label: Australian English
en-AU.spelling: British-derived spelling conventions: colour, favourite, customise, organise, moisturiser, centre, enrol (not color, favorite, customize, organize, moisturizer, center, enroll).
en-AU.date_format: Day before month, e.g. '20 March' or '20/03/2026'. Avoid the US month-first order (e.g. 'March 20' or '03/20/2026').

currency.guidance: Use the plain '$' symbol for prices aimed at a local Australian audience already operating within their own market context. Only use 'A$' when the copy could otherwise be read in a cross-market context alongside another dollar currency, which none of these tasks do.

en-AU.measurement: Metric units where units are mentioned (km, kg, °C, cm).
en-AU.tone_notes: Plain, direct, moderately informal marketing tone. Do not force slang markers (e.g. 'mate', 'arvo', 'no worries') or cultural stereotypes where they would not naturally appear in ordinary brand marketing copy.
en-AU.source_note: A defensible general-conventions summary for demonstration purposes, not a comprehensive style guide and not sourced from any specific company's internal locale documentation.
